description: Headline claims backed by archived research evidence. Each claim names a repository-relative file and an RFC 6901 JSON pointer; the pointer target, after the optional derivation, equals 'value' exactly. 'display' is the rounded form used in prose. Claims stated only in prose or code have json_pointer null and a 'note'; when they also carry 'text', that text must occur in the file. tools/ci/verify_evidence.py checks every entry.

derivations.length: number of items in the array (or keys in the object, or characters in the string) at the pointer
derivations.sum: sum of the numeric array at the pointer
derivations.union_length: number of distinct items in the array at the pointer together with the arrays at the 'with' pointers
derivations.difference: sorted items of the array at the pointer that are in none of the arrays at the 'minus' pointers
